IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.objects O JOIN sys.schemas S ON O.schema_id = S.schema_id WHERE O.NAME = '[DIM_COMENTARIO]' AND O.TYPE = 'U' AND S.NAME = '[dbo]')
CREATE TABLE [dbo].[DIM_COMENTARIO]
	(
	 [ID_DIMCOMENTARIO] int,
	 [COMENTARIO] nvarchar(4000)
	)
WITH
	(
	DISTRIBUTION = ROUND_ROBIN,
	 CLUSTERED COLUMNSTORE INDEX
	 -- HEAP
	)
GO

COPY INTO [dbo].[DIM_COMENTARIO]
(ID_DIMCOMENTARIO 1, COMENTARIO 2)
FROM 'https://azpaciencareetl.dfs.core.windows.net/datosprocesados/dw/DIM_Comentario.parquet'
WITH
(
	FILE_TYPE = 'PARQUET'
	,MAXERRORS = 0
)
--END
GO

SELECT TOP 100 * FROM [dbo].[DIM_COMENTARIO]
GO
